cases.sentence: Они прибыли в Саламин и там возвещали слово Божье в ___.
cases.explain: «иудейских синагогах» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed God’s word in the Jewish synagogues. They also had John as their attendant.

cases.sentence: Он был с ___ Сергием Павлом, человеком большого ума.
cases.explain: «римским проконсулом» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.

cases.sentence: Он был с римским проконсулом Сергием Павлом, человеком ___.
cases.explain: «большого ума» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.

cases.sentence: Рука Господа обращена против тебя, ты будешь поражен слепотой и некоторое время не будешь видеть ___.
cases.explain: «солнечного света» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season!” Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.

cases.explain: «израильского народа» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.

cases.sentence: Он возвысил народ во время пребывания его в Египте и ___ вывел их оттуда .
cases.explain: «могучей рукой» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.

cases.sentence: Во ___ написано: «Ты Сын Мой, сегодня Я родил Тебя!»
cases.explain: «втором псалме» — after the preposition «во», for location or topic.
cases.translation: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,

cases.sentence: И в ___ Он говорит: «Ты не дашь Твоему Святому увидеть тление» .
cases.explain: «другом месте» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Therefore he says also in another psalm, ‘You will not allow your Holy One to see decay.’

cases.sentence: Собрание разошлось, но ___ и благочестивые люди из обращенных в иудаизм пошли за Павлом и Варнавой.
cases.explain: «многие иудеи» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.

cases.sentence: Собрание разошлось, но многие иудеи и ___ из обращенных в иудаизм пошли за Павлом и Варнавой.
cases.explain: «благочестивые люди» — after the preposition «из», the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.

cases.sentence: Иудеи подговорили ___ из знатных семей и начальников города, и те возбудили преследование против Павла и Варнавы и выгнали их из своих пределов.
cases.explain: «благочестивых женщин» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their borders.

cases.sentence: Иудеи подговорили благочестивых женщин из ___ и начальников города, и те возбудили преследование против Павла и Варнавы и выгнали их из своих пределов.
cases.explain: «знатных семей» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their borders.
